name: Kilo Code
short: Unified AI gateway with a rotating pool of free models available to authenticated and anonymous users, no credit card required.

plans.name: Free models
plans.notes: Several models available at no cost, subject to rate limits. Available to both authenticated and anonymous users; anonymous users are limited to 200 requests per hour per IP. Free model pool changes over time — check the live catalog.

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go
plans.notes: Hundreds of paid models through one OpenAI-compatible API; model IDs use provider/model format.
